description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/options-version (and the MSysCompactErrors reads): the queries used the plural name MSysCompactErrors, but the table made by the MDB to dbVersion120 compaction is MSysCompactError, so its rows were never read. The rich MDB fixture r-cplx-rebuild-rb-rich2-mdb is compacted with CompactDatabase(source, output, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120 = 128) (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); the output is opened read-only; the refreshed TableDefs and the Fields of MSysCompactError are listed and SELECT * FROM MSysCompactError is read (DBEngine.Errors after it).
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
